title.zh: 曇無竭：誦普門品，獅鷲卻獸
title.en: Tanwujie: Reciting the Universal Gate Chapter, Lion and Vulture Scatter the Beasts

label.zh: 劉宋元嘉初（西域求法僧）
label.en: Early Yuanjia era, Liu Song (a pilgrim to the Western Regions)

note.zh: 與《高僧傳》所載西行求法僧曇無竭（宋元嘉年間出走西域）時代相合。
note.en: Agrees in period with the pilgrim Tanwujie recorded in the Gaoseng zhuan who left for the Western Regions in the Yuanjia era.

synopsis.zh: 劉宋元嘉初，黃龍沙門曇無竭精勤苦行，常誦《法華經・普門品》，與徒屬二十五人西行天竺，備經險難。至舍衛，路逢群象，竭虔心誦念，感師子從林中出，象群奔退；復有野牛群吼而至，竭勵念如初，忽有大鷲飛來，牛群驚散無蹤，因得免脫。原書夾注出《法苑珠林》。
synopsis.en: In the early Yuanjia era of the Liu Song, the monk Tanwujie of Huanglong, austere and diligent, constantly recited the Universal Gate chapter of the Lotus Sutra. With twenty-five followers he travelled west to India through every peril. Near Srāvastī the party met a herd of elephants; Tanwujie recited with devotion, and a lion charged from the forest, putting the elephants to flight. Next a roaring herd of wild buffaloes bore down; he recited with redoubled vigour, and a great vulture swooped down, scattering the buffaloes without a trace — and so the party escaped. The source cites the Fayuan zhulin.

paragraphs.text:
宋元嘉初，有黃龍沙門曇無竭者，精勤苦行，常誦法華普門品，與徒屬二十五人西游天竺，備經險難，竭志彌堅。既達舍衛，路逢群象，竭䖍心誦念，遂感師子從林逃出，象即奔退。復有野牛群吼而至，將欲加害，竭勵念如初，忽有大鷲飛來，驚散無蹤，因得免脫。〔注：法苑
珠林〕
